label: Variant A — Primary residence, bought with us
subject: Happy Home Anniversary, [First Name]!
body:
Hey [First Name(s)],

Happy Home Anniversary! It's hard to believe it's already been [N] years since you closed on your home at [Property Address] — time flies.

We pulled together a quick market snapshot for your home — the current RPR automated estimate is around [$VALUE] (based on current variables - let us know if you have a different opinion). The attached personalized report has the full breakdown, including recent trends and comparable sales in your area.

We'd love to grab a few minutes for a quick check-in call — whether it's about a move, a refinance, home improvements, or just what's next for you and your family.

Hope you and yours are doing wonderfully!

Warmly,
Orit & Scott

(Estimated values/trends referenced are approximate and not a guarantee of current market value.)

subject: Happy Anniversary on Your Investment Property!
body:
